WHAT THIS SECTION COVERS How to open the app and reach the main screen.
STEPS 1. Open the app. 2. Enter your email address. 3. Enter your password. 4. Tap the login button. 5. After a successful sign-in you arrive at the main screen. 6. The app can remember your sign-in so you may not need to type your password every time. If you tap Logout, you will need to sign in again next time.
MAIN SCREEN You will see a welcome message and a list of buttons. The buttons you see depend on your account. That is normal.
LOGOUT At the bottom of the main screen, tap Logout when you have finished. On some limited versions the button may say Exit instead.
LIMITED / OFFLINE VERSIONS Some company versions of the app open with little or no sign-in and mainly allow Create Report and View Reports. If you use one of those versions, many business buttons will not appear. That is expected.

TECHNICIAN You mainly work on jobs and contracts assigned to you.
You can normally: • Create and view reports and quotations • Use Job Work for your own jobs • Use Management for jobs assigned to you • Service your contracts • Use Notifications and Email • Use Commission if it is shown on your screen
You normally cannot: • Manage all staff accounts • See every other technician’s Job Work • Reopen completed jobs • Create Management companies • Use Location Finder (this is not available to technician accounts)
If a button is missing, your account does not include that access. Ask your administrator if you believe something should be available.

The main screen is your home menu. Buttons are grouped into sections such as Quick Actions, Operations, Business, Tools, and System.
BUTTONS YOU MAY SEE • Create Report — make service reports, quotations, agreements, and similar documents • View Reports — open PDFs saved on this phone or in company cloud folders • Job Work — your service jobs • Management — jobs for management companies • Contracts — recurring customer contracts • Email — write an email and attach files • Commission — leads and commission (only if shown) • Notifications — alerts and updates • Messaging — only if shown on your account • Maps — only if shown on your account • Router — only if shown on your account • Search — only if shown on your account • PDF to Word — only if shown on your account • Billing / Invoices — only if your account has been given invoice access • Logout — sign out
IMPORTANT • Work View and How To Use App are not normally shown to technicians on the main screen. • Location Finder is not available to technician accounts. • Some buttons such as General Quotes, Service agreement, and ERA may be hidden on the main screen. Those options are still available inside Create Report.

WHAT IT IS FOR Notifications shows alerts about work assigned to you and important updates.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Notifications
WHAT YOU MAY SEE • Job assignment updates • Management work updates • Contract updates • Message alerts • Other work reminders
HOW TO USE 1. Open Notifications. 2. Read the list. 3. Tap a notification when it links to a job, contract, or related screen. 4. You can mark items as read or remove them from your own list where the app allows.
You only see your own notifications.

WHAT IT IS FOR Create Report is where you make PDFs for site visits, quotations, agreements, and related documents.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Create Report
You will see sections such as REPORTS, QUOTATIONS, AGREEMENTS AND COMPLIANCE, and TEMPLATES.
REPORT OPTIONS • Service Report — full visit report • Action Form — shorter action document • Contract Quotation — 4 / 6 / 8 / 12 part quotes • Bird Quote • Generic Quotation — standard wording from the built-in list • Custom Quotation — write your own lines • Service Agreements • ERA • Safety Statement • Custom Template — set your branding options • Create Custom Report — service report using your saved template
SERVICE REPORT — STEP BY STEP 1. Tap Create Report. 2. Tap Service Report. 3. Enter or confirm the customer / site details. 4. Before saving, choose the correct routing option so the report goes to the right place: • Job • Management • Contract 5. Enter inspection findings and site details. 6. Add recommendations. You can pick common recommendation wording where offered. 7. Add products used. 8. Add photos or signatures if those options are shown. 9. Tap Preview if you want to check the PDF first. 10. Save / generate the report. 11. Find it later under View Reports, or from the related Job / Management / Contract screen.
PRODUCT ENTRY 1. Start typing the product name. 2. Matching products appear underneath. 3. Tap the correct product. 4. If it is not in the list and manual typing is allowed, keep typing the full name. 5. Enter the quantity and any other required details such as batch or location. 6. Add further products the same way.
IMPORTANT Saving a report does not automatically complete a Job Work or Management job. After the report, still use Mark follow up or Mark complete when needed. For contracts, still use Mark as Routine or Mark as Call Out when the visit type requires it.

WHAT IT IS FOR View Reports lets you open PDFs that are already on this phone or stored in company cloud folders.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then View Reports
LOCAL REPORTS • Reports — PDFs saved on this phone • Quotations — quotation PDFs saved on this phone
CLOUD AND STORAGE • Stored Reports • Report folders (cloud) • Contract files (cloud) • Cloud Quotations • Management Jobs • Jobs Folder
OTHER DOCUMENTS • Service Agreements • ERA • View Behinds
VIEW / SHARE / DOWNLOAD When a file list or report dialog offers these actions: • View — opens the PDF on the phone • Share — sends the PDF using another app on the phone (email, WhatsApp, Drive, and similar) • Download — keeps a copy in the app’s normal local report area so you can open it again from View Reports then Reports
TIP If you cannot find a file on this phone, check the matching cloud folder. Company cloud copies remain available even if this phone’s local files were cleared.

WHAT IT IS FOR Job Work is for one-off / service jobs that are not Management company jobs and not normal contract routines.
WHO CAN USE IT Technicians and admins. Technicians see jobs assigned to them. Admins see all jobs.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Job Work
FILTERS • Active — open jobs • Follow ups — still need another visit • Completed — finished jobs (still available to open later) • All — everything
CREATING A JOB 1. Open Job Work. 2. Tap Add job. 3. Enter Customer Name. 4. Enter Address. 5. Enter Contact. 6. Enter Email if available. 7. Enter Issue. 8. Assigned Technician is normally you. 9. Tap Submit Job.
OPENING A JOB The list shows customer, address, technician, and status. Tap a job to open full details.
ACTIONS YOU MAY SEE • Create report • View reports • View visit history • Mark follow up • Mark complete • Set follow-up date • Save address • Change email • Open map • Browse historical reports • Back
MARK FOLLOW UP Use Mark follow up when today’s visit is done but the job still needs another visit. • The job stays open • Status becomes Follow Up Required • Visit history is updated • Reports already created stay available
MARK COMPLETE Use Mark complete only when no further visit is currently required. • The job moves to Completed • It is not deleted • Reports and visit history remain available • An admin can reopen it later if needed
SET FOLLOW-UP DATE Set follow-up date records a diary date. It is not the same as Mark follow up. Use Mark follow up when the status should move to Follow Up Required.
COMMON MISTAKES • Creating a report but forgetting Mark follow up or Mark complete • Looking under Active when the job is already under Follow ups or Completed • Expecting to reopen a completed job without an admin

WHAT IT IS FOR Management is for jobs belonging to management companies / property groups. Each company can have its own report folder and automatic job references such as HS001.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Management
COMPANY LIST Tap a company to see its jobs.
CREATING A MANAGEMENT JOB (TECHNICIAN) 1. Open the company. 2. Tap Add management job / Create job. 3. Enter property / address. 4. Enter contact. 5. Enter issue. 6. The job is assigned to you. 7. The next job reference is created automatically. You do not type the number.
FILTERS Active / Follow up / Completed / All
DETAIL ACTIONS • Create report • Mark follow up • Mark complete • View company reports • Open map • Save address • Back
Status meanings match Job Work: Active, Follow Up Required, Completed.
IMPORTANT Technicians do not create Management companies. Ask an admin if a new company is needed.

WHAT IT IS FOR Contracts are recurring customer sites with planned visit frequency.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Contracts
HUB OPTIONS • Add Contract • View Contracts • Behinds List • Due List • Export options may appear for admins
COLOURS ON VIEW CONTRACTS • Red — never visited or overdue • Yellow — due soon • Normal — up to date
Stats at the top show Total / Behind / Due / Up-to-Date.
MARK AS ROUTINE Use this for a normal scheduled visit. 1. Find the contract. 2. Tick Mark as Routine. 3. Confirm Yes. 4. Today becomes the latest routine visit. 5. The next routine date is calculated from the visit frequency. 6. The yearly routine total increases.
MARK AS CALL OUT Use this for an extra visit that is not the normal routine. 1. Tick Mark as Call Out. 2. Confirm Yes. 3. The call-out is recorded. 4. The yearly call-out total increases. 5. Important: the next routine date does not change.
OTHER CONTRACT ACTIONS Tap a contract for Contract Options: • Update Last Visit • Create Report • Action Form • Route
Also use: • View Reports • View Maps • Assets • View Visits • Remind me
Long-press edit/delete is only available if your account allows it.
VIEWING CONTRACT ASSETS 1. Open Contracts. 2. Open the Contract. 3. Tap Assets. 4. The screen shows the number of Externals, Internals, Fly Units, Insect Monitors, Moth Pots and any custom Assets recorded for the site.
EDITING ASSETS 1. Tap Edit Assets. 2. Enter the quantity beside each Asset type. 3. If the Asset is not listed, tap Add Custom Asset. 4. Enter the Asset name. 5. Enter the quantity. 6. Tap Save Assets.
Assigned technicians can edit Assets for their own Contracts.
Admin and Super Admin can edit Assets for all Contracts.
COMMON MISTAKES • Using Call Out when you meant Routine (next date will not move) • Creating a report but forgetting Mark as Routine / Mark as Call Out

WHAT IT IS FOR Quotations create a priced PDF proposal for a customer.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Create Report then choose a quotation type
The main Quotes button on the home screen may be hidden. Use Create Report instead.
GENERIC QUOTATION (MOST COMMON) 1. Create Report then Generic Quotation. 2. Enter Customer Name. 3. Enter Customer Address. 4. Confirm Date. 5. Tap Issue and select the type of work. 6. Standard quotation wording appears automatically. 7. Review or edit the wording. 8. Enter Base Price (euro). 9. Optional: tap Add second issue and enter a second price. 10. Choose VAT 13.5 percent or 23 percent. 11. Optional: password protect the PDF. 12. Tap Preview PDF to check, or Generate PDF to save. 13. The quotation is saved on this phone and also stored in the company quotations area. 14. Later: View Reports then Quotations or Cloud Quotations. 15. Share from the PDF screen, or attach it in Email.
STANDARD QUOTE WORDING Standard quotation options contain pre-written work descriptions. Selecting one fills the wording automatically. You can review or edit before generating the PDF.
CUSTOM QUOTATION 1. Create Report then Custom Quotation. 2. Enter customer / company details. 3. Type a line description and price. 4. Tap Add Item. 5. Add more lines as needed. 6. Add images or signature if shown. 7. Choose deposit options if shown. 8. Choose VAT. 9. Preview PDF / Generate PDF.
CONTRACT QUOTATION 1. Create Report then Contract Quotation. 2. Choose 4 Part, 6 Part, 8 Part, or 12 Part. 3. Enter equipment quantities and prices. 4. Enter annual fee and other required fields. 5. Tap Generate PDF Quote.
BIRD QUOTE 1. Create Report then Bird Quote. 2. Enter the bird / materials details shown on screen. 3. Generate the PDF.
FINDING A QUOTATION LATER View Reports then Quotations (this phone) View Reports then Cloud Quotations (company cloud) Email then browse quotations when attaching files

Billing / Invoices appears only if your account has been given invoice access.
If you do not see Billing / Invoices, that is normal for most technicians.
If you do see it: 1. Open Billing / Invoices. 2. Create an invoice if allowed. 3. Enter customer details, template, amount, VAT, and notes. 4. Tap Generate PDF and save. 5. Use View PDF, Download, Email, Share, or Delete where available.

WHAT IT IS FOR Commission tracks sales leads and commission.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Commission (only if shown)
GENERATE LEAD 1. Tap Generate Lead. 2. Enter premise name and address. 3. Enter price quoted. 4. Choose reason: Job or Contract. 5. For Contract, commission is calculated automatically (shown with a per-quarter figure). 6. For Job, commission may show as TBC until materials are updated later. 7. Admins can assign the lead to a staff member. 8. Save.
VIEW LEADS 1. Tap View Leads. 2. Search or browse. 3. Update materials / commission where allowed. 4. Mark paid where your account allows. 5. Admins may export a spreadsheet where that option is shown.

EMAIL 1. Main screen then Email. 2. Enter the recipient. 3. Enter the subject and message. 4. Attach a report, quotation, or invoice from the browse options. 5. Send using your phone’s email app when prompted.
SHARING FROM A PDF SCREEN When viewing a PDF: • View opens it • Share sends it through another app on the phone • Download keeps a local copy in the app’s report area
This is useful for WhatsApp, email apps, Drive, and similar.

These tools appear only when your account includes them.
ROUTER Plan a multi-stop day. 1. Open Router. 2. Select stops / contracts. 3. Optimise or build the route if offered. 4. Open maps / navigation. 5. Save or view created routes. 6. Create a route PDF if that option is shown.
MAPS Create or edit a site map for a contract when Maps is shown on your account.
SEARCH Find contracts, work, and related items when Search is shown.
PDF TO WORD Convert a PDF to a Word document when this button is shown.
MESSAGING Opens only if Messaging is shown on your account. If it closes immediately, your account does not have full messaging access.
NOT INCLUDED FOR TECHNICIANS • Location Finder is not available to technician accounts • Work View is not normally shown to technicians on the main screen

NEED then WHERE TO GO
Completed service job Job Work then Completed
Open service job again Job Work then tap the job
Management job Management then company then Completed / Active / Follow up
Job report Open the job then View reports or View Reports then Jobs Folder
Management report Open the job / company then View company reports or View Reports then Management Jobs
Contract report Contract then View Reports or View Reports then Contract files (cloud)
Quotation View Reports then Quotations or Cloud Quotations
Invoice Billing / Invoices
Local PDF on this phone View Reports then Reports
COMMON TASKS
I need to create a Service Job Main then Job Work then Add job then fill details then Submit Job
I need to create a Management Job Main then Management then company then Add management job then Create job
I need to create a new Management Company Main then Management then Add management company then Save company (admin)
I need to assign a technician Use Assigned Technician when creating, or Change technician on an existing job (admin)
I need to create a report Main then Create Report then Service Report or open the job/contract and tap Create report / Create Report
I need to record a follow-up Open the job then Mark follow up then optional Set follow-up date
I need to complete a job Open the job then Mark complete
I need to reopen a job Open Completed job then Reopen job (admin)
I need to record a Contract Routine Contracts then View Contracts then Mark as Routine then Yes then create report if needed
I need to record a Call Out Contracts then View Contracts then Mark as Call Out then Yes
I need to create a quotation Create Report then Generic Quotation (or Custom / Bird / Contract Quotation) then Generate PDF
I need to email a report Email then attach from browse options or open the PDF then Share
I need to find an old report View Reports then choose the matching local or cloud folder
I need to download a PDF Open the PDF list then Download or Share

I cannot see a button Your account does not include that option, or you are on a limited / offline version.
I cannot see another technician’s job Technicians normally only see their own Job Work and assigned Management jobs.
My job is in the wrong filter Check Active, Follow ups, Completed, and All.
I cannot assign another technician Technicians cannot reassign Job Work / Management jobs. Ask an admin.
I cannot reopen a job Only an admin can Reopen job.
I cannot find a report Check View Reports local folders and the matching cloud folder (Jobs Folder, Management Jobs, Contract files).
I cannot open a PDF Try View again, re-download from cloud, or enter the password if the PDF is protected.
I cannot find my quotation View Reports then Quotations or Cloud Quotations.
I cannot see Location Finder Location Finder is not available to technician accounts. This is normal.
I cannot see Work View / How To Use App Those main-screen buttons are not normally shown to technicians.
Messaging opens then closes Your account does not have full messaging access.
GENERAL Some options depend on your account access. Contact your administrator if you believe you should have access.
GLOSSARY Active — job still open Follow Up Required — another visit is needed Completed — finished, but still available to open later Routine — normal scheduled contract visit (moves next visit date) Call Out — extra contract visit (does not move next routine date) Service Job — a Job Work job Management Job — a job under a management company, often with a code like HS001 Contract — recurring customer site Report — PDF of work done Quotation — PDF price proposal Behind — contract visit overdue Due — contract visit due soon

START OF DAY 1. Sign in. 2. Check Notifications. 3. Check Job Work (Active and Follow ups). 4. Check Management for assigned company jobs. 5. Check your Contracts for due / behind sites.
ON A JOB 1. Open the assigned job. 2. Check customer, address, and issue. 3. Carry out the visit. 4. Create report (choose Job or Management routing as required). 5. Tap Mark follow up or Mark complete. 6. Set follow-up date if another visit is planned.
CONTRACT VISIT 1. Find the contract. 2. Create Report or Action Form. 3. Tick Mark as Routine or Mark as Call Out correctly. 4. Confirm.
QUOTATION Create Report then Generic Quotation then fill details then Generate PDF.
END OF JOB Confirm the PDF is saved and the job/contract status is correct.
Do not use Location Finder, staff management, or owner-only tools.

ADMIN You can oversee day-to-day company work as well as your own tasks.
You can normally: • See all Job Work and Management jobs • Assign and reassign technicians • Create Management companies • Reopen completed jobs • Use Billing / Invoices • Use Dashboard • Use Audit Logs • Wider Contracts access and exports where shown
AUDIT LOGS Audit Logs shows important completed activity by staff, such as Contract visits, reports uploaded, jobs created or completed, and quotations created.
Filter by staff member, by date (Today, 7 Days, 30 Days, or All), and by activity such as Reports, Contracts, Job Work, Management, Quotations, Billing, or Stock.
SUPER ADMIN (APPLICATION OWNER) The application owner can do everything an admin can, plus staff account management, Work View on the main screen, Location Finder, How To Use App, and other owner tools.
Some extra buttons only appear when that access has been turned on for the account.

FILTERS • Active — open jobs • Follow ups — still need another visit • Completed — finished jobs (still available to open later) • All — everything
CREATING A JOB 1. Open Job Work. 2. Tap Add job. 3. Enter Customer Name. 4. Enter Address. 5. Enter Contact. 6. Enter Email if available. 7. Enter Issue. 8. Assigned Technician is normally you. 9. Tap Submit Job.

ACTIONS YOU MAY SEE • Create report • View reports • View visit history • Mark follow up • Mark complete • Set follow-up date • Save address • Change email • Open map • Browse historical reports • Back
MARK FOLLOW UP Use Mark follow up when today’s visit is done but the job still needs another visit. • The job stays open • Status becomes Follow Up Required • Visit history is updated • Reports already created stay available
MARK COMPLETE Use Mark complete only when no further visit is currently required. • The job moves to Completed • It is not deleted • Reports and visit history remain available • An admin can reopen it later if needed
SET FOLLOW-UP DATE Set follow-up date records a diary date. It is not the same as Mark follow up. Use Mark follow up when the status should move to Follow Up Required.

WHAT IT IS FOR Contracts are recurring customer sites with planned visit frequency.

MARK AS ROUTINE Use this for a normal scheduled visit. 1. Find the contract. 2. Tick Mark as Routine. 3. Confirm Yes. 4. Today becomes the latest routine visit. 5. The next routine date is calculated from the visit frequency. 6. The yearly routine total increases.

WHAT IT IS FOR Quotations create a priced PDF proposal for a customer.
HOW TO OPEN Main screen then Create Report then choose a quotation type
The main Quotes button on the home screen may be hidden. Use Create Report instead.
GENERIC QUOTATION (MOST COMMON) 1. Create Report then Generic Quotation. 2. Enter Customer Name. 3. Enter Customer Address. 4. Confirm Date. 5. Tap Issue and select the type of work. 6. Standard quotation wording appears automatically. 7. Review or edit the wording. 8. Enter Base Price (euro). 9. Optional: tap Add second issue and enter a second price. 10. Choose VAT 13.5 percent or 23 percent. 11. Optional: password protect the PDF. 12. Tap Preview PDF to check, or Generate PDF to save. 13. CONTRACT QUOTATION 1. Create Report then Contract Quotation. 2. Choose 4 Part, 6 Part, 8 Part, or 12 Part. 3. Enter equipment quantities and prices. 4. Enter annual fee and other required fields. 5. Tap Generate PDF Quote.
BIRD QUOTE 1. Create Report then Bird Quote. 2. Enter the bird / materials details shown on screen. 3. Generate the PDF.
FINDING A QUOTATION LATER View Reports then Quotations (this phone) View Reports then Cloud Quotations (company cloud) Email then browse quotations when attaching files

START OF DAY 1. Sign in. 2. Check Notifications. 3. Check Job Work (Active and Follow ups). 4. Check Management for assigned company jobs. 5. Check your Contracts for due / behind sites.
ON A JOB 1. Open the assigned job. 2. Check customer, address, and issue. 3. Carry out the visit. 4. Create report (choose Job or Management routing as required). 5. Tap Mark follow up or Mark complete. 6. Set follow-up date if another visit is planned.
CONTRACT VISIT 1. Find the contract. 2. Create Report or Action Form. 3. Tick Mark as Routine or Mark as Call Out correctly. 4. Confirm.
QUOTATION Create Report then Generic Quotation then fill details then Generate PDF.
END OF JOB Confirm the PDF is saved and the job/contract status is correct.
Do not use Location Finder, staff management, or owner-only tools.

SUPER ADMIN / APPLICATION OWNER
You have full access to the live features of the app.
EXTRA MAIN-SCREEN TOOLS • Work View — calendar of staff work, add jobs from the calendar, reminders • Location Finder — last known locations for staff who are sharing location • How To Use App — this staff manual (with Admin view / Technician view preview) • Super Admin — create and edit staff accounts, roles, and access switches • Audit Logs — important completed activity by staff, such as Contract visits, reports uploaded, jobs created or completed, and quotations created
AUDIT LOGS 1. Open Audit Logs from the main screen. 2. Filter by staff member. 3. Filter by date: Today, 7 Days, 30 Days, or All. 4. Filter by activity, such as Reports, Contracts, Job Work, Management, Quotations, Billing, or Stock.
STAFF ACCOUNTS 1. Open Super Admin. 2. Create or edit a staff member. 3. Set role: tech, admin, or super_admin. 4. Turn access switches on or off (for example Search, Maps, Router, Messaging, Billing, and similar). 5. Save.
LOCATION FINDER 1. Open Location Finder. 2. Review staff last known locations. 3. Select a person for more detail where offered.
WORK VIEW 1. Open Work View. 2. Move between days or weeks. 3. Review events for technicians. 4. Add a job from the calendar when needed. 5. Use reminders / widget support where set up.
REMEMBER Technician guides should never instruct technicians to use Location Finder. Admin day-to-day work uses Dashboard, Job Work, Management, Contracts, Billing, and assignment tools. Owner tools are for system oversight and staff access.
